validation_rules: candidate_id must exist in 303 review packet
confirmed_asset_name is required before any future onboarding request draft
asset_type is required before protocol candidate selection
location_or_room is required before future physical context mapping
trust_level must be selected by a human
disposition must be one of ignore, monitor_read_only, prepare_future_onboarding_request, needs_more_research
human input cannot submit print actions
human input cannot deploy protocol translator
human input cannot deploy IoT bridge
human input cannot arm Real Alpha
human input must write to review-state only when a later write-route patch is separately planned and approved

proposed_future_routes.allowed_purpose: Save human identity labels and disposition only.
proposed_future_routes.forbidden_purpose: No device control, no pairing, no print, no translator, no bridge, no arm.

proposed_future_routes.allowed_purpose: Read saved human review state after future route exists.
